title: Congruent numbers in residue classes 5, 6, and 7 modulo 8
exact_target: Does every positive integer in residue class five, six or seven modulo eight occur as the area of a rational right triangle?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8900009 (AMR-088-0009). CC BY 4.0.
Christian Wuthrich, \emph{Open problems in number theory}, lecture slides (December 2011) slides headed Congruent number problem and Conjecture (following the triangle examples).
